title: Ferri 2015 ecological emotional looming sounds
citation: Ferri, F., Costantini, M., Tajadura-Jimenez, A., Valjamae, A., & Vastano, R. (2015). Emotion-inducing approaching sounds shape the boundaries of multisensory peripersonal space. Neuropsychologia, 70, 468-475.
notes: Experiment 2 specification. The three IADS sounds and a white-noise comparator are listed in the filmstrip. The sample-accurate sound files must be supplied before the trial pool can be generated.

implemented_controls: Tactile timing at 300–3000 ms in 300-ms steps, with D0 at −500 ms on trials that still present the sound.
One second of silence, three seconds of audio and one second of silence.
12 repetitions per sound and tactile time across 4 blocks, with 160 sound-present catch trials.
Four named source slots pending import of the exact study versions.
implementation_gaps: Exact licensed IADS source WAVs 276, 110 and 720, their Ferri three-second edits/envelopes and the exact white-noise comparison file.

A clinically governed, calibrated external electrical target scheduler for the Digitimer DS7A. The original MATLAB/Cogent task and button acquisition hardware are required to verify delivery and response timing.
Absolute acoustic output calibration for the study headphones, original hardware and corresponding ear-level measurement.
Original trial order, per-sound catch quotas and per-block balancing constraints.

reported_tactile_target.site: Intermediate phalanx of the right middle finger
reported_tactile_target.calibration: Start at minimum and increase to clear perception. Intermix 10 tactile and 5 empty trials. If performance is below 100%, increase the intensity by 5 mA and repeat.
reported_tactile_target.output_mode_note: The article calls the DS7A constant-current and describes a constant-voltage pulse. Absolute amplitude and delivered electrical waveform require confirmation.

reported_response.target_trials: Press the response button with the left index finger as quickly as possible when touch is felt.
reported_response.setup: Blindfolded participant with the right hand palm down.
reported_response.task_software: Custom MATLAB task by Gaspare Galati using Cogent 2000 and Cogent Graphics.

reported_pps_analysis.white_noise_comparator: Presented in the full PPS task schedule and excluded from the published valence analysis following SAM validation.
reported_pps_analysis.d0_analysis_scope: D0 supplies a unimodal tactile reference and sits outside the five fitted delay pairs. Its role in baseline subtraction is unspecified.
reported_pps_analysis.paired_delay_bin_centers_derivation: Arithmetic means of adjacent reported D1–D10 timings; fits use the five observed delay bins.
reported_pps_analysis.fit_exclusion: Excluded participants whose RMSE exceeded the group mean by more than two standard deviations for both sigmoid and linear fits.

toolkit_choices.schedule: Seeded balanced shuffle for replay. The original paper specifies randomized trial order. It gives aggregate catch and block counts.
toolkit_choices.geometry: Delay is the independent stimulus coordinate. The renderer's trajectory fields only provide a three-second scaffold; study distances are unspecified.
toolkit_choices.acoustic_preview: Supply the authorized three-second, 44.1 kHz Ferri study versions with their intensity envelopes already applied. Import them with the exact listed source labels and preserve mode. No ecological preview audio is provided.
